data.one_liner: Hashes passwords using the BCrypt algorithm.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to generate BCrypt hashes and verify passwords. It is a pure Dart implementation of the jBCrypt algorithm.
use_when: Implement secure password storage in authentication systems
Need deterministic hashing with built‑in salt generation
Require a lightweight dependency for password hashing
avoid_when: Building a full authentication framework that already includes password hashing
Using a platform‑specific native crypto library for performance
strengths: Pure Dart, no native code or platform dependencies
Supports UTF‑8 and password length validation
weaknesses: Only password hashing, no higher‑level auth features
No built‑in user management or session handling
data.setup_notes: Add bcrypt to pubspec.yaml and import 'package:bcrypt/bcrypt.dart'. No build_runner or native permissions required.
data.minimal_example:
final String hashed = BCrypt.hashpw('password', BCrypt.gensalt());
final bool isValid = BCrypt.checkpw('password', hashed);
